title: ghd Black Friday deals 2026: the prices worth waiting for
seoTitle: ghd Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Prices to Wait For
description: ghd straighteners and dryers are full price right now. Here are last year's Black Friday prices, this year's targets and which ghd to buy.
intro:
**Short answer: wait. Almost every ghd styler is at full price today, with the Platinum+ at £249 and the Chronos at £299, and last year's sales took £40 to £60 off both.** ghd usually runs 20–30% off for Black Friday and the big retailers match it, so unless you need one this week, hold off until late November.

ghd also put its prices up this year (the Platinum+ was £239 and the Gold £189 in 2025), so last year's sale prices are a rough guide rather than an exact target. These prices were checked on 26 October 2026.

body:
## ghd prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the prices ghd stylers sold for in last year's sales (late November to December 2025), mostly on Amazon and at Boots. ghd's RRPs have gone up by £10 since then, so allow a little extra.

- **ghd Platinum+:** £199 (RRP now £249)
- **ghd Chronos:** £239 (RRP now £299)
- **ghd Gold:** £139 (RRP now £199)
- **ghd Original:** £103.99 (RRP now £149)
- **ghd Max (wide plates):** £146
- **ghd Helios dryer:** £123.99–£139 (RRP £179)
- **ghd Duet Blowdry:** £278.99 (RRP £379)
- **ghd Glide hot brush:** £118.99
- **ghd Rise volumising brush:** £139
- **ghd Chronos Curve wands and tongs:** £129.99–£148.99

If you see a ghd at or below these prices, it's a good deal. If the discount is less than 20%, it's probably worth waiting a few more days.

## Which ghd should you buy?

**ghd Platinum+** is the one most people should get. It adjusts its heat as it goes, which means less damage on fine or coloured hair, and it's usually the best value of ghd's premium stylers.

**ghd Chronos** is ghd's top straightener. In side-by-side tests it's a little faster, glides more smoothly and leaves more shine, and it's better for curling. Worth it if you style every day; otherwise the Platinum+ is close enough for less money.

**ghd Gold** is lighter and a good all-rounder, especially for curls and waves. **ghd Original** is the cheapest way into the brand. For long or thick hair, the wide-plate **Max** or **Chronos Max** gets through it faster.

For dryers, the **Helios** is the sensible buy. The **Duet Style** and **Duet Blowdry** dry and style in one, but they're expensive, so only buy one at a sale price.

## When do ghd prices drop?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**, and Cyber Monday on **30 November**. In recent years ghd has run around 20–30% off on its own site, with Amazon, Boots, John Lewis, LookFantastic and Very following. Amazon often goes lowest on older models. ghd's Christmas gift sets come out in October, but they're rarely discounted much.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday for ghd straighteners?

Yes. Every main ghd styler was full price when we checked in late October, and last year's sales took 20% or more off the most popular models.

### Where is cheapest for ghd on Black Friday?

Amazon and Boots were cheapest for most ghd stylers last year, with ghd's own site and John Lewis close behind. Prices tend to be matched quickly.

### How do I avoid fake ghd straighteners?

Buy from ghd itself or a big approved stockist like Boots, John Lewis, Very or Amazon (sold by Amazon). ghd warns that fakes are sold on marketplaces, social media and copycat sites, sometimes through sponsored ads, and carry a risk of burns and electric shock. Its guarantee only covers genuine products.

### Is the ghd gift set worth it?

Only if you're giving it as a present. The extras are nice, but you're paying more than for the styler alone, and the styler is the thing that gets discounted on Black Friday.
